theorems.name: Submission.ind_md_diagonal_weak_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), (⨆ j, μ j univ) < ∞ → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Eucl P)), StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ R, ν R univ < ∞) ∧ ∀ (R : ℕ) (F : Set (Eucl P)), IsClosed F → F ⊆ closedBall 0 (R : ℝ) → limsup (fun j => μ (φ j) F) atTop ≤ ν R F
